profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Royal Credit Union
profile.summary: Full-Stack Software Developer with a demonstrated history of working in the logistics, financial services and insurance industries for over 8 years. Skilled in C#, JavaScript, React.js, TypeScript, .NET Core MVC & Web API, Cypress, Node.js, .NET Framework, HTML/CSS, jQuery, MS SQL Server, MongoDB, VB.NET, Git & GitHub, Jenkins

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Eau Claire, Wisconsin, United States · Remote

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Developed a Greenfield full stack project which included a UI in React.js with Typescript using MUI React UI tools, and a .NET Core Web API which allowed C.H. Robinson customers to estimate future costs for freight procurement.

Developed a massive new feature for C.H. Robinson’s flagship freight analytics application in React.js with Typescript and multiple .NET Core Web APIs which included many different types of graphs and plots drawn in real time using d3.js

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed a Greenfield full stack project which included a UI in .NET Core MVC, multiple .NET Core Web APIs and MongoDB database which allowed claim handlers to easily search existing claims.

Rewrote a .NET Framework UI in React.js with Node.js Express backend and Cypress e2e testing with much improved user experience to handle loss consultations.

Developed a UI with React.js and d3.js for data visualization of microservice interdependencies via force-directed graphs and tree graphs.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · .NET Core · .NET Framework · Node.js · Express.js · C#

positions.title: Developer/Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Designed, built, and tested Windows Forms applications in C# and VB.NET to automate business
processes for a variety of lines of business in the Ameriprise home office which contributed to over
$1,000,000 of savings annually from a team of 4 developers.
Served as Tech Lead and Subject Matter Expert for a suite of over 10 applications supporting the
Unclaimed Property team who is responsible for retention of client assets.
Maintained legacy applications in Visual Basic 6 and led effort to rebuild legacy applications in C#.

positions.title: Technology Leadership Development Program Associate
positions.description: Rotated between three areas of technology within Ameriprise, Business Automation, Application Development, and Architecture.

positions.title: Quality Assurance Intern
positions.description:
Wrote programs to automate over 150 regression test cases for complex web applications 
Implemented Integration with Rally Agile Management software to easily run automated test cases and 
record results
